charge:
EEOC FORM 5 (11/09)
CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Charge No. 410-2026-10001
EEOC Office: Atlanta District Office
Charging Party: Amara Montgomery
City/State: Chicago, IL
Respondent: Keystone Analytics
DISCRIMINATION BASED ON: Religion
DATE(S) DISCRIMINATION TOOK PLACE: Earliest 01/27/2025 Latest 07/21/2025
THE PARTICULARS ARE:
1. I was employed by Keystone Analytics beginning before January 27, 2025. The conduct
described below began on or about January 27, 2025 and continued through July 21, 2025.
2. I applied for a promotion for which I was qualified and was denied it in favor of a less
experienced employee.
3. I believe I have been discriminated against because of my religion, in violation of
applicable federal law.
notice:
U.S. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY COMMISSION
Atlanta District Office
NOTICE OF CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Date of Notice: 09/19/2025
To: Keystone Analytics
Re: Charge No. 410-2026-10001
This is notice that a charge of employment discrimination has been filed against your
organization. No action is required on your part at this time. A position statement may be
requested.
